tasks.instructions:
### P8 (successor) - build the immigrant-headship probe under RULINGS Q and R

YOUR PREDECESSOR HALTED CORRECTLY AND BUILT NOTHING. It found, mid-sweep, a cube that contradicted a spec premise, refused to write a gated artifact on a premise under revision, and reported. The seat re-verified every figure live, took it to the operator, and BOTH forks are now ruled and amended into §6 (amendments #7+#8, commit 1f6eacb). Your job is the build the halt deferred - now on settled ground. The halt's own evidence is scratchpad-only and NOT an earned verdict: re-derive everything you publish.

**WHAT IS RULED (read §6's RULINGS P/Q/R block for the binding text; this is orientation only):**
- RULING Q - the immigrant/non-immigrant ownership RATIO takes StatCan **43-10-0060-01**, SETTLED member, per modeled geography: MTL_RMR 0.9682, QC_RMR 0.9223, province 0.9219 (HORS_RMR). One transport axis remains, METRIC, and its DIRECTION IS DELIBERATELY UNMEASURED - do not assert one; it is the QFE's question at Task 26.
- RULING R - immigrant HEADSHIP has no free source; it transports the model's own general headship curve, `borrowed_prior` on one axis (immigrant status): MTL_RMR 0.4332, QC_RMR 0.4394, HORS_RMR 0.4529.

**THE SEAT'S OWN MEASUREMENT, PINNED SO YOUR PROBE REPRODUCES IT RATHER THAN RE-DISCOVERS IT.** Cube pid 43100060; dimension positions `geography.gender.age.immigrant.visible-minority.education.indicator.0.0.0`; geography members MTL CMA=15, Quebec CMA=17, Quebec province=13, Canada=1; immigrant-status members non-immigrants=2, immigrants(all)=3, admitted-last-10-years=4, admitted-more-than-10-years-ago=5, non-permanent-residents=6; indicator members ownership=5, living-alone=8; gender/age/vismin totals=1, education total=6. Verify these ids from LIVE metadata rather than trusting this list - if any resolves differently, that is a finding, not a typo to paper over.

**THE NOTE MUST CARRY ALL FIVE OWNERSHIP READINGS AS FACTS** (the halt's table carried three; the seat measured the other two): non-immigrant, all-immigrant, recent(<10y), settled(>10y), and non-permanent-resident, at MTL CMA / Quebec CMA / Quebec province. The recency spread is not decoration - it is the evidence base for the cost §6 records (the netting discount is small at the settled reading precisely because the large newcomer effect lives in the recency composition), and it is the input a Tranche-2 decision will read. Also emit the living-alone shares (indicator 8) that ground ruling R's floor gate.

**HEADSHIP - the absence must be EARNED and STATED AS SCOPED.** Re-run the sweep yourself: `getAllCubesListLite`, title-select, `getCubeMetadata` over the selected pool, and report the counts your run measures (the halt measured 8,206 / 994 / 156 immigrant-dim / 16 maintainer-dim / EMPTY intersection - if your numbers differ, publish YOURS and say so). The verdict sentence must scope the absence to the title-selected pool and must never read as "does not exist": the 43-10-0060 find is the live proof that a scoping clause can hide the answer, and §6 now says so in the spec itself. Report the two cheapest-first checks explicitly both ways (98100134 from P3 and 98100231 from T13b - the halt measured both NEGATIVE for an immigrant dimension).

**RULING R's TRANSPORTED VALUES MUST BE COMPUTED, NEVER TYPED.** Derive them in the probe from the tree's own committed surfaces - the population-weighted aggregate of the banded `headship_by_age` curve over `pop-as-rmr-base.xlsx`, `Scenario.REFERENCE`, year 2026, per geography - and assert your computed values against the figures §6 now states. GOTCHA the seat hit live, costing a silently-empty result set: `Series.astype(str)` on an enum column yields the REPR (`<Scenario.REFERENCE: 'reference'>`), not `str(x)` (`'Scenario.REFERENCE'`), so a string filter silently matches nothing. Compare against the enum object, or map with `str`. This is the sibling of the run-1 carry that `str(Geography.X)` yields `'Geography.MTL_RMR'` and emitters must use `.value`.
Implement the FLOOR GATE as an executable check, not a sentence: transported headship must EXCEED the immigrant living-alone share at the same geography (each person living alone maintains exactly one household). Mutation-test it - a value below the floor must RED.

**JUNCTION GOTCHA, measured live by the seat:** this cube's geography labels carry TRAILING NON-BREAKING SPACES - `'Montréal (CMA), Que.\xa0\xa0'`. That is this arc's 2026-07-21 junction class (labels carrying trailing whitespace and footnote digits). Key off member IDs, and if you match on labels anywhere, normalize explicitly and say so.

**PROBE DISCIPLINE - all of it binds (charter §Probe discipline, battle-tested P2-P7):**
- The note is GENERATED by running the script. Never hand-write or hand-edit it. Every factual claim traces to code that COMPUTES it or to an inline CITATION. Run the live-regen byte-diff and report it.
- THE RECURRED DEFECT CLASS as a DEPTH LADDER: depth-1 a hand-typed value; depth-2 an ADJECTIVE or gloss beside a correctly-computed number; depth-3 an inference from a correct, correctly-cited number that is LOGICALLY IRRELEVANT to the conclusion drawn. The question at every claim is "does the measured quantity ENTAIL this sentence?", never "is the number right?". P6 closed with zero wrong values and wrong sentences at four depths.
- FLOOR GUARD: a NOT-FOUND / LOCATED / UNKNOWN verdict must be EARNED. A vacuous-but-successful response (empty 200, zero-result search, wrong body) RAISES to UNKNOWN-PROBE-FAILED and never launders into a verdict. Mutation-test the guard; an UNREACHABLE mutant is not a SURVIVING mutant - write the fixture.
- DUAL-PATH citation gate: success AND fallback paths both need evidence-strength gates - a bare token or planted sentence must FAIL.
- Reachability/skip: a code fault must NOT launder into `pytest.skip`; skip only on a network-class EXCEPTION TYPE plus confirmed unreachability, probed with the SAME HTTP METHOD as the real call (Law 1b).
- `json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen(url).read())`, never `pd.read_json`. WDS bulk responses do NOT preserve request order - key off each response's own coordinate, never `zip`. Cells can return `status:FAILED` with an EMPTY `vectorDataPoint`, so a blind `[0]` raises.
- REUSE `demoflow/probes/_wds.py` (ruling E): `new_run()`, `Fact`, `provenance_header`, `post`, `table_number`, `table_url`. Every narrative figure is a registered Fact tagged `derived` or `cited`.
- PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 or unique filenames for mutation batteries (stale-pyc trap, measured at run 9).
- The contract gates DISCOVER probes by glob (ruling E) - make P8 satisfy them rather than exempting it.
- Emit a DECISION block in the P5b shape, every token a function of what the run measured. It needs at minimum a headship verdict, the ratio-source tokens, and the floor-gate result.

**SCOPE - probe ONLY.** Do NOT wire any value into `demand/immigrant_inputs.py`; plan Task 25b consumes this note and is a separate run. Do NOT edit the spec or the plan - §6 is settled on exactly these two questions, and a measurement contradicting it is fork-class: raise SEAT_QUESTION and stop.

SEAT-RUN ADDENDUM (binding): commit NOTHING - the seat commits at run close. Probe/scratch work under a run-unique scratchpad subdirectory you create; never touch a path you did not create. Finish with `./scripts/test-all.sh` from the worktree root; real tail.
